    BrickAccessibility.exists_specialBiserial_pathData

    Skowroński–Waschbüsch: representation-finite biserial algebras are special biserial #

    Over an algebraically closed field, a basic representation-finite biserial algebra Λ carries admissible special biserial path data on Λᵐᵒᵖ (Skowroński–Waschbüsch, Lemma 2, with Jans' theorem that representation-finite algebras are distributive and Kupisch's description of distributive algebras).

    source
    theorem BrickAccessibility.exists_specialBiserial_pathData (k : Type u) [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] (Λ : Type u) [Ring Λ] [Algebra k Λ] [FiniteDimensional k Λ] (hbasic : Statement.IsBasic k Λ) (hrf : Statement.IsRepresentationFinite Λ) (hbis : Statement.IsBiserial Λ) :
    ∃ (Q : Statement.FinQuiver) (D : PathData Q Λᵐᵒᵖ), Submodule.span k (Set.range fun (p : Q.V × List Q.A) => D.pval p.1 p.2) = ⊤ ∧ D.IsAdmissible ∧ D.IsSpecialBiserial ∧ ∀ (c : Q.V → k) (d : Q.A → k), ∑ v : Q.V, c v • D.e v + ∑ a : Q.A, d a • D.α a ∈ D.RadGe k 2 → c = 0 ∧ d = 0

    Skowroński–Waschbüsch, in the form used for Corollary 5.6.
